import os

from google.cloud import storage

def create_presigned_url(bucket_name, object_name, expiration=3600):
    """Generates a pre-signed URL for a given object."""
    client = storage.Client()
    bucket = client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(object_name)
    url = blob.generate_signed_url(expiration=expiration, method='GET')
    return url

from google.cloud import storage

def get_object_metadata(bucket_name, object_name):
    """Retrieves metadata for a given object."""
    client = storage.Client()
    bucket = client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(object_name)
    return blob.metadata

from google.cloud import storage

def list_objects(bucket_name, prefix=''):
    """Lists objects in a bucket with a given prefix."""
    client = storage.Client()
    bucket = client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blobs = bucket.list_blobs(prefix=prefix)
    return [blob.name for blob in blobs]

from google.cloud import vision

def ocr_document(bucket_name, object_name):
    """Performs OCR on a stored document object."""
    client = vision.ImageAnnotatorClient()
    from google.cloud import storage
    storage_client = storage.Client()
    bucket = storage_client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(object_name)
    content = blob.download_as_bytes()
    image = vision.Image(content=content)
    response = client.document_text_detection(image=image)
    return response.full_text_annotation.text

from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def translate_text(text, target_language='en'):
    """Translates text extracted from a stored document."""
    client = translate.Client()
    result = client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

from google.cloud import language_v1 as language

def summarize_text(text):
    """Summarizes content extracted from a stored asset."""
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=text, type_=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    summary = client.summarize(document=document).summary
    return summary

from google.cloud import language_v1 as language

def embed_metadata(text):
    """Embeds object metadata and extracted text for search."""
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=text, type_=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    entities = client.analyze_entities(document=document).entities
    return entities
